_doc: Signs on the pilot stretch: only what OSM implies per junction (grade tagged, no post position, no face). Candidate posts are in poles.json (a sign post and a lamp post are not told apart from the air).

junctions.control: traffic signals (OSM highway=traffic_signals on both Colfax carriageways)

implied_by_osm.colfax_bus_lanes: designated|yes (OSM today; NOT in the 2022 or 2023 imagery: see PILOT.md)

junctions.faces: not read: no source from the air. Street-level imagery (Mapillary, E3) or Kevin's captures would give the posts and the faces.
